capabilities: Render the vault as a GPU-rendered 3D brain graph with themes, shapes and camera flythroughs
Track, replay and time-lapse AI agent reads, writes and searches as colored trails
Enforce per-agent permissions such as hidden folders and read-only via an optional bridge
Generate daily activity reports, context packs and agent teamwork features like claims and handoffs
Search notes and inspect hover cards inside the 3D view
extras: Free and open source (Apache-2.0), desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.11.4+. Runs a local HTTP listener (127.0.0.1:27183) with per-agent keys; no telemetry and nothing leaves the machine by default. Full user manual lives in MANUAL.md rather than the README. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is a static 2D link map and shows nothing about what AI coding agents do to notes behind the user's back.

relations.evidence: When an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, Cursor or anything you script) reads or writes a note
relations.plugin: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, Cursor

requires.name: AI agent such as Claude Code (optional, only for agent tracking features)

summary: 3D graph plugin that renders the vault as an animated brain and tracks AI agent reads and writes with replay, per-agent permissions and audit logs.
